stem.text: In the circuit shown, contact may be made at any point along the $3\,\Omega$ resistor (potentiometer).

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit: a 9 V battery and a series chain of 2 ohm, 3 ohm and 4 ohm resistors in one loop, with a ground connection at the left; the 3 ohm resistor has a sliding contact connected to an output voltage terminal

stem.text: The battery has e.m.f. $9\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance.
